COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.2336 of 2023
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. K.K. Tiwari, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Atul Bhatt, learned counsel for 
respondent nos.1 & 2.
3. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
respondent nos.3 & 4.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. By means of this writ petition, petitioner 
seeks the following reliefs:-
“(i) To issue a writ, order or direction in the 
nature of certiorari for quashing the impugned 
order dated 08.09.2023 (Annexure No.9) issued 
by respondent no.4.
(ii) To issue a writ, order or direction in the 
nature of mandamus commanding and directing 
the respondents to extend the benefit of 1st ACP 
to the petitioner after completion of 10 years of 
service in accordance with Government Order 
dated 31.12.2013.
(iii) To issue a writ, order or direction in the 
nature of mandamus commanding and directing 
the respondents to extend the benefit of 2nd
ACP to the petitioner after completion of 16 
years of service in accordance with Government 
Order dated 31.12.2013.
(iv) To issue a writ, order or direction in the 
nature of mandamus commanding and directing 
the respondents to re-fix the pay of the 
petitioner after granting the benefit of 1st and 
2nd ACP in pursuant to Government Order dated 
31.12.2023.
(v) To issue a writ, order or direction in the 
nature of mandamus commanding and directing 
the respondents to release the arrears of 
difference along with interest at the prevalent 
rates.”
6. Learned counsel for the respondent(s) 
prays for and is granted six weeks’ time to file 
counter affidavit(s). 2
7. Thereafter, two weeks’ time is granted 
to the petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit.
8. List this matter on 20.03.2024.
9. In the meantime, petitioner may 
implead ‘State of Uttarakhand’ as party￾respondent in the writ petition.
 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 29.12.2023
AK 3
